body:
> This doesn't make sense as a cull mode. It seems to have the same behaviour as `CULL_DISABLED` but with the addition of a check to fully disable shadows when inside an occluder. That isn't what was proposed in [godotengine/godot-proposals#1320](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1320) and the API makes no sense.
> 
> At best this should be an optional checkbox to enable. But I am doubtful of the need for that, it would be good to see a proposal for this behaviour

Wow, thanks for the quick feedback! 🙂 I didn't expect a response so quickly otherwise I would have replied yesterday.

You're right that the cull mode feels awkward. The reason I added it because of the linked proposal's suggestion. I also didn't want to change this behavior for all light occluders to retain backwards compatibility.

But, I'm happy to rework the API however you see fit, whether that's a separate boolean property on OccluderPolygon2D or something else entirely.          

I encountered this issue while working on my own oblique-angled top-down game and looked for similar reports and found #44236 and #79783. None of the existing cull modes seem to solve this. My player character would go behind a wall and the shadow would light up the interior of the wall. 

Would you be open to the behavior itself if the API is reworked? Or would you prefer I open a dedicated proposal first so the approach can be discussed properly?
